name: Validate Build Process Complete
description: Comprehensive build validation ensuring all OpenCode features (CLI, ACP, TUI, browser) are correctly included in build process with artifacts verification and testing

tasks.description: Verify TypeScript compilation and build script execution

prompt.template:
Verify OpenCode compilation and build process:

1. Run typecheck: {{typecheckCommand}}
   - Ensure zero TypeScript errors
   - Check for any @ts-ignore or @ts-expect-error comments (anti-pattern)
   - Verify all imports resolve correctly

2. Run build: {{buildCommand}}
   - Ensure build script completes successfully
   - Check build output directory exists
   - Verify no build warnings or errors

3. Validate build script (script/build.ts):
   - Check platform targets are configured
   - Verify all source files are included
   - Ensure external dependencies are bundled correctly

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ Typecheck passes with 0 errors
- ✅ Build completes without errors
- ✅ Build artifacts created in expected location

**Common Issues**:
- Missing dependencies in package.json
- Incorrect tsconfig.json paths
- Build script platform configuration errors

tasks.description: Validate CLI command endpoints are included in build

prompt.template:
Validate CLI endpoints are correctly included in build:

1. **Check CLI entry points**:
   - Verify bin/opencode and bin/opencode.cmd exist
   - Check src/cli/ directory is included in build
   - Validate command registry (src/command/) is bundled

2. **Test CLI commands** (if possible without full install):
   - Check help output: node [build-output] --help
   - Verify command list is complete
   - Ensure all documented commands are present

3. **Validate CLI dependencies**:
   - Check all CLI tool imports are resolved
   - Verify CLI-specific packages are bundled
   - Ensure platform-specific binaries are included

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ CLI entry points exist and are executable
- ✅ All CLI commands registered
- ✅ CLI dependencies bundled correctly

**Red Flags** 🚨:
- 🚨 Missing CLI commands in build output
- 🚨 Unbundled dependencies (import errors)
- 🚨 Platform-specific issues (Windows .cmd missing)

tasks.description: Validate ACP server and client functionality in build

prompt.template:
Validate ACP (Agent Client Protocol) functionality in build:

1. **Check ACP server components**:
   - Verify src/acp/server.ts is included
   - Check ACP protocol handlers are bundled
   - Validate WebSocket/HTTP transport support

2. **Check ACP client components**:
   - Verify src/acp/client.ts is included
   - Check Docker and SSH transport implementations
   - Validate delegation tool (acp_delegate) is available

3. **Validate ACP dependencies**:
   - Check WebSocket libraries are bundled
   - Verify SSH client dependencies
   - Ensure Docker client libraries included

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ ACP server and client modules bundled
- ✅ All transport types supported
- ✅ ACP tool registered and available

**Common Issues**:
- Missing native dependencies (SSH, Docker)
- WebSocket transport not configured
- ACP delegation tool not registered

tasks.description: Validate TUI (Terminal UI) features in build

prompt.template:
Validate TUI (Terminal UI) features in build:

1. **Check TUI components**:
   - Verify src/tui/ directory is included
   - Check session sidebar implementation
   - Validate impulse visualization tools
   - Ensure memory agent UI components are bundled

2. **Check TUI dependencies**:
   - Verify terminal rendering libraries (ink, etc.)
   - Check UI component libraries are bundled
   - Validate keyboard input handling

3. **Test TUI initialization** (if possible):
   - Check TUI can start without errors
   - Verify rendering doesn't crash
   - Ensure graceful degradation on unsupported terminals

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ All TUI components bundled
- ✅ Terminal libraries included
- ✅ TUI can initialize without errors

**Red Flags** 🚨:
- 🚨 Missing terminal rendering libraries
- 🚨 TUI crashes on initialization
- 🚨 Sidebar or visualization tools missing

tasks.description: Validate browser automation (Playwright) integration in build

prompt.template:
Validate browser automation integration in build:

1. **Check Playwright tools**:
   - Verify src/tool/playwright*.ts files are included
   - Check all browser automation tools registered:
     - playwright_browser_navigate
     - playwright_browser_click
     - playwright_browser_snapshot
     - playwright_browser_evaluate
     - (and 15+ other browser tools)
   - Validate tool registry includes all playwright tools

2. **Check Playwright dependencies**:
   - Verify playwright package is bundled or marked external
   - Check browser binaries installation handling
   - Validate playwright configuration

3. **Validate browser tool metadata**:
   - Check tool schemas are correct
   - Verify parameter validation
   - Ensure error handling for missing browsers

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ All Playwright tools registered
- ✅ Playwright dependencies configured
- ✅ Browser installation instructions available

**Common Issues**:
- Playwright marked as external but not in dependencies
- Browser tools not registered in tool registry
- Missing browser installation prompts

tasks.description: Verify build artifacts structure and completeness

prompt.template:
Verify build artifacts are complete and correct:

1. **Check output directory structure**:
   - Verify build output directory exists (dist/, build/, or similar)
   - Check platform-specific builds are created
   - Validate executable permissions on binaries

2. **Check artifact contents**:
   - Verify all source modules are bundled
   - Check external dependencies are handled correctly
   - Validate asset files are included (templates, docs, etc.)

3. **Check artifact size and optimization**:
   - Verify build size is reasonable
   - Check for unnecessary inclusions
   - Validate minification/optimization applied

4. **Platform-specific validation**:
   - Linux: Check ELF binary format
   - macOS: Check Mach-O binary format  
   - Windows: Check .exe exists

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ Build artifacts exist in expected location
- ✅ All required modules included
- ✅ Platform-specific builds correct
- ✅ Build size reasonable (<100MB typical)

**Red Flags** 🚨:
- 🚨 Build size >200MB (likely includes unnecessary files)
- 🚨 Missing platform-specific builds
- 🚨 Executable permissions not set

tasks.description: Run comprehensive test suite to validate build

prompt.template:
Run comprehensive test suite to validate build:

1. **Run full test suite**: {{testCommand}}
   - Verify all tests pass
   - Check test coverage is maintained
   - Ensure no flaky tests

2. **Run integration tests**:
   - Test CLI command execution
   - Test ACP delegation workflow
   - Test TUI rendering
   - Test browser automation (if browsers installed)

3. **Validate test results**:
   - Check for any failures or warnings
   - Verify expected test count
   - Ensure critical paths are tested

4. **Performance checks** (optional):
   - Test startup time
   - Check memory usage
   - Validate response times

**Success Criteria**:
- ✅ All tests pass ({{testCommand}})
- ✅ Integration tests successful
- ✅ No performance regressions
- ✅ Critical paths validated

**Common Issues**:
- Flaky tests due to timing issues
- Missing test dependencies
- Environment-specific test failures
- Browser tests failing (missing browsers)
